summary: Two 25-year-old elk hunters - Andrew Porter of Asheville, NC and Ian Stasko of Salt Lake City, UT - killed by a lightning strike in the Rio Grande National Forest; reported missing Sept 13; extensive multi-agency search (air crews, dog teams, drones, volunteers); bodies located ~Sept 17-18; Conejos County coroner confirmed lightning as preliminary cause of death Sept 22
location: Rio de Los Pinos Trailhead area, Rio Grande National Forest
notes: APPROXIMATE date: fatality pinned to Friday 2026-09-12 (weekday-verified), the storm day - pair sighted alive Friday ~10am near Spruce Hollow Trailhead (fellow hunters via Colorado Sun); fiancee Bridget Murphy's account has them heading back to the car as storms rolled in Friday Sept 12. Last satellite contact Sept 11 ~3pm; vehicle + camping gear at trailhead (device reported non-functioning); reported missing Sept 13; bodies located 'Thursday afternoon' Sept 17 per Cville Right Now vs recovered from Rio de Los Pinos Trailhead ~11am Sept 18 per CCSO - recovery-day conflict unresolved. Coroner Martin confirmed preliminary lightning cause Sept 22; full autopsy pending ~8 weeks.
